statement: Define DevRelay's WorkItemVerification module so one exact WorkExecution result is independently evaluated against its approved verification plan and required evidence before ChangeIntegration.
objectives: Bind verification to one approved WorkItem, immutable ExecutionAttempt, exact ChangeSetDraft, and candidate workspace.
Collect and validate complete subject-bound evidence through replaceable verifier adapters without allowing self-approval.
Evaluate every verification-plan and required-evidence obligation deterministically.
Preserve immutable verification attempts, failures, evidence continuations, and checkpoint replay.
Authorize ChangeIntegration consideration only after a separate exact WorkItemVerificationGate approval.
constraints: WorkItemVerification cannot execute implementation work, mutate approved scope or the dependency DAG, integrate changes, or create completion facts.
Verifier adapters produce evidence only; Core and WorkItemVerificationGate own validation and approval.
Evidence must identify exact subject bytes, producer identity and version, invocation, and raw output.
Every verification retry or continuation is immutable and linked.
External hosts enforce verifier permissions and isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: One invocation binds one exact work item, execution attempt, proposed change, evidence bundle, verification policy, repository base, and candidate workspace.
All work-item verification-plan checks and required-evidence obligations receive explicit validated dispositions.
Configured verifier adapters are selected deterministically from approved policy and evidence kinds.
Checkpoint replay makes zero additional verifier calls.
Only a Gate-approved verified result may advance to ChangeIntegration, without claiming integration.
assumptions: The approved V1 lifecycle and WorkExecution verification barrier already settle the module boundary.
The OpenSpec adapter is used only for bounded requirements proposal and normalization; no live upstream CLI claim is made.
